purpose: Wave C reviewer findings reproduced against the bytes on disk now, the record corrections that do not need a rerender, and what the corrected modules would measure and bind when one runs.
notAnApproval: This approves nothing and promotes nothing. Every family below keeps its correction_required record.

rerender.why: the driver resolves each family's bytes under RCAP_BUNDLE_EXTRACT and the Master Library extract is not present in this clone; an exhaustive search of the filesystem finds no copy of it. Outbound HTTPS to court publishers is refused by this environment's egress policy, so the official bytes cannot be fetched either.
rerender.consequence: every correction below is proved at the module level by its own canaries and re-measured against each family's committed blank. None is proved against a family's regenerated artifact, because no family artifact could be regenerated.
rerender.whatWouldCloseIt: mount the extract, set RCAP_BUNDLE_EXTRACT, run scripts/implement-rcap-official-forms-d1.mjs, then re-run every generator in this directory and hand the new bytes to an independent reviewer.
